vars._comment: Optional. Reusable prefixes; ${name} in any config value or a projects/*.md 'path:' expands to these, so a repo-root move is a one-line change.

frameworkRoot: (optional) ${code}/meta-os — defaults to resolving the instance's systems/ symlink
claudeHome: (optional) /Users/you/.claude — engine home whose session logs feed the usage widget; defaults to ~/.claude

harness._comment: Optional. Directory of hand-authored harness declarations (one YAML per repo, shape in docs/harness.example.yaml) for the Harness widget. Relative to instanceRoot; defaults to <instanceRoot>/harness. May also live in the instance's meta-os.config.json.

metaCli._comment: Optional, off by default. Enables the meta-cli engines widget and the meta-cli hints in Usage / Sprint Lanes / Skills. bin = the meta binary (absolute path if the server runs without ~/.local/bin on PATH). runsDir = where meta writes runs (META_RUNS_DIR), relative to instanceRoot; omit to skip run counts. providers.<name>.plan is what you DECLARE about each subscription — it cannot be detected and is shown as declared. May also live in the instance's meta-os.config.json.

flow._comment: Optional. Feeds the Flow tab (/api/flow): open PRs waiting for you, drift between vault, git and GitHub, and every git worktree as a lane. Read-only: git runs without taking locks and never fetches; gh only reads. scanRoots are parent directories searched scanDepth levels deep for repositories (a directory holding a .git directory); repos adds explicit repository paths; exclude drops a path prefix or a directory name. github.user defaults to the gh-authenticated login; github.orgs limits the PR search and the repositories read to these owners (plus the user), empty means every GitHub remote found. Items are linked through the backlogs below, by branch names of the form <space>/<KEY>-slug. mergedWindowDays: how far back a merged PR whose item is not DONE is reported. staleDays: uncommitted files older than this are drift. prLimit: PRs read per repository (all states, newest first). Caches: githubCacheSec and scanCacheSec, served stale while refreshing. timeoutMs applies to each git/gh call. laneLedger: optional JSON file (relative to instanceRoot) of lane entries naming a worktree path, or a repo + branch, with a session field; null shows no session. May also live in the instance's meta-os.config.json.

_backlogsComment: Vault-native: `path` is the space directory in your vault; the server reads <space>/{raw,wiki,output}/*.md and <space>/sprints/*.md directly, so there is no derived backlog.json to regenerate. A `path` ending in .json still reads a pre-built backlog document. One entry per space — add as many as you have.

memory._comment: Optional. Configurable memory topology. Omit this whole block and memory falls back to the default: the instance's own memory/{raw,wiki,output} as the sole canon root plus vaults/* as federated mounts — byte-for-byte the prior behaviour. 'roots' are canon (counted as the raw→wiki→output pipeline); each has a 'layout' of flat | tier/project | project/tier. 'federated' mounts are navigation context, never counted as canon. ${var} expands here exactly as in backlogs. Broken/dangling paths are skipped and reported (topology.skipped), never fatal.

auth._comment: OIDC — Google (now) or Tessera (later). enabled = UI login gate. enforce = API requires JWT (Google id_token). allowedEmails strongly recommended so random Google accounts cannot access your vault.
